operator_notes_2026_08_10: NOT a genuine dead-end — the earlier 'confirmed Cloudflare block, no fix
available' verdict is superseded. /nuachtlitir/ (the trained listing
page) really is behind a genuine Cloudflare Managed Challenge blocking
both headless AND headful Playwright — but the bulletin PDF itself lives
on wp-content/uploads, an asset path that is NOT challenged at all (a
plain HTTP GET to a known filename returns 200 immediately, confirmed
2026-08-10). The only real obstacle was the filename itself, which
encodes two values that are not simple date substitutions: a sequential
'newsletter number' and a liturgical Mass-reading cycle letter (A/B/C).
CRACKED both via the Wayback Machine CDX index (~50 real historical
filenames, 2022-2026): filename shape is
Parish-Newsletter-{N}-for-Sun-{A/B/C}-{DDMMYYYY}.pdf under
wp-content/uploads/{YYYY}/{MM}/. N = weeks between the target Sunday and
the first Sunday counted that calendar year (resets every 1 Jan), +1 —
verified an EXACT match (zero drift) across 8 independent real
filenames spanning 2024, 2025 and 2026. The cycle letter follows the
standard 3-year A/B/C rotation keyed off the calendar year, EXCEPT any
date on/after that year's First Sunday of Advent already uses next
year's letter (confirmed via the exact Dec 2023 SunA->SunB flip at the
real Advent boundary).
Implementation: naomhfionan_bulletin_url()/naomhfionan_newsletter_number()
in harvester/utils.py, liturgical_cycle_letter() in
harvester/liturgical.py. site_type:naomhfionan_numbered_pdf
(harvester/replay.py, _try_naomhfionan_predicted_pdf) skips Playwright
and the challenged /nuachtlitir/ page entirely: builds the predicted
wp-content/uploads URL for the target Sunday and fetches it directly via
plain HTTP, with a small +-1 number fallback for the rare skipped-week
numbering seen in older (2022) filenames.
Confirmed 2026-08-10 via direct curl: predicted URL for 9 Aug 2026
(.../2026/08/Parish-Newsletter-32-for-Sun-A-09082026.pdf) returns HTTP
200 with real bulletin content — matches the site's own live listing
page (whose HTML — fetchable via curl even though a browser can't render
it — links that exact same file for today's date).
do_not: Do not point this recipe back at /nuachtlitir/ or any other HTML page —
it is a genuine Cloudflare Managed Challenge that blocks every browser,
headless and headful alike; there is nothing to click there.
Do not assume the newsletter number is a simple date substitution — it
is a separate weeks-since-January counter, see harvester/utils.py.
Do not hardcode a specific year's number/letter — always derive both
from the target date via naomhfionan_bulletin_url().
